summary: Layer 1B expands the directly exposed public-company universe around education regulatory and finance rails. The strongest direct exposure is Nelnet because its public filings explicitly tie loan servicing, servicing technology, outsourcing, and education customers to Federal Direct Loan, FFELP, private education loan, and Title IV regulatory regimes. Sallie Mae is an obvious reference lender tied to private education loans but is less of a hidden compliance-rail supplier. Grand Canyon Education and Covista are direct regulated education operators/service platforms where approvals, licensure requirements, accredited institutions, and enrollment monetization make compliance rails a gating factor rather than a pure software product exposure.
